definition: `CausesIn c x r`: c is a cause of x's being r, as fire is a cause of the heat of hot things. It is not identified with moving (`MovesIn`): causing a perfection need not be a present reduction from potency to act. 'Cause of being' is the instance r = esse.
note: Causal scope and originating/sustaining/primary/secondary distinctions, source locators, examples, competing reading and open semantic burdens: docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. The shared relation has no built-in temporal, modal, transitivity or exclusive-cause law; mere enablement and possession of a perfection are not effective production.
